extraction.Name: Ernest Blue Back
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Ponca City, Okla. (Agency not explicitly named)
extraction.Buyer: Land was sold to Miller Bros., Ponca City, Okla.; $2700.00 received for entire allotment
extraction.Occupation/Income: $15.00 per annum from inherited lands. No contributions from Government or State or County.
extraction.NOTES: Good health, no funds; wife and five children dependent upon him; at the time of sale, the consideration probably represented full value of such land; patent delivered at Agency; date of redemption expired: none; notarized November 21, 1928, before Notary Public whose commission expires Aug. 3, 1931, Kay County, State of Oklahoma
